portfolio: P4 of enhancements-architecture-spec.md (Play stack; CO17 shares the book)
verdict: PROCEED. Premise CONFIRMED and STRENGTHENED. The opening book is asymmetric (10 White-bot lines vs 4 Black-bot lines) and steering silently no-ops for several Dimensions depending on the bot's colour. Original framing ('only the Black side has gaps') is INCOMPLETE: BOTH colours have uncovered dimensions. selectOpening, OPENING_BOOK, the Dimension set, eco.json, and the single call-site all EXIST exactly as the portfolio describes. No STOP.

selectOpening.status: EXISTS — pure; (botColor, weakest, pick)->OpeningEntry; filters pool by botColor, weight 3 for targets===weakest else 1; deterministic given pick; has a length-0 fallback that returns OPENING_BOOK[0] (NOTE: returns a possibly-wrong-colour entry — see collision report)

nextBookMove.status: EXISTS — pure; feeds the bot its colour's moves while the game matches the prefix

steeringNote.status: EXISTS — returns 'Steering toward your weakest area (X) with the Y.' when opening.targets===weakest, else 'Playing the Y.' — the silent-no-op surfaces HERE as a non-steering note

Dimension.status: EXISTS — exactly 5: tactics | endgameConversion | openingAccuracy | timeManagement | resilience

eco_table.status: EXISTS — 40 entries (measured), {eco,name,uci[]}; loaded by eco.ts; the new lines' prefixes ARE present here (Sicilian B50, Caro-Kann ...d5 B12, King's Gambit C30) so additions are eco.json-grounded

localizedOpeningName_FR_overlay.status: EXISTS — ECO_NAME_FR map; provides the FR/EN parity precedent for any new opening name shown to the user

selectOpening.note: THE only runtime caller. Bot colour = OPPOSITE of player. Player White => bot Black => selectOpening('b',...). This is the path with the worst coverage (bot=Black missing tactics + endgameConversion).

steerDimension_override.note: Coach C7 'play-steered' step writes app.steerDimension; it flows straight into selectOpening. Completing the book makes that coach step actually steer for either colour — C7-friendly by construction, no coach concern hard-coded here.

Math_random_purity.note: Math.random() lives at the CALL-SITE (Play.svelte:167), NOT inside selectOpening. The core stays pure/deterministic-given-pick (AP-CHESS-22 doctrine). New lines must not change that boundary.

tests_present.covers: line legality (all lines legal from start), 'covers both bot colours and all five dimensions' (BUT asserts on the UNION of colours — masks the per-colour gap; upgrade target), selectOpening colour filter + ~3:1 bias + variety, nextBookMove on/off book for both colours, steeringNote wording
tests_present.gap: NO test asserts per-colour Dimension coverage, and NO test asserts steering is non-degenerate when bot is Black for a Dimension only White covers. This is the regression the PR must lock.
